# ListSignal

> Live business intelligence for 14M+ online businesses: tech stacks, Shopify apps, revenue and employee estimates, hiring signals with posting dates, SEO scores, and contact data for Shopify stores, SaaS products, agencies, and every digital business. New domains are discovered within hours of getting a TLS certificate. Data is queryable by REST API and by MCP.

## Developer API
The fastest way for an agent to use ListSignal. Free tier: 1,000 lookups/month, no card.
- [Developer docs](/developers): quickstart, endpoints, plans, error format
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](/openapi.json): the machine-readable contract
- MCP server: POST https://listsignal.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0, API-key auth). Tools: listsignal_get_company, listsignal_search_companies, listsignal_dataset_stats.
- Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json with actionable detail.

## Key Endpoints
- GET /api/v1/company/{domain}: one company's full record
- GET /api/v1/search?tech=&country=&business_model=&hiring=: filtered company search
- GET /api/v1/technologies: tracked technologies with live counts
- GET /api/v1/stats: live dataset statistics, refreshed every 60 seconds

## Pricing
- Free: browse + API key with 1,000 calls/month, contactability without addresses
- Starter ($39/month): all filters, CSV export, contact emails, 5,000 API calls/month
- Pro ($149/month): 50,000 rows/month, saved searches, alerts, 25,000 API calls/month
- Custom list ($499 one-time): 250 qualified companies matching your ICP, delivered in 48h
- [Pricing](/pricing)
